scope: Read-only static analysis of official released Hardened DLL. No execution, injection, patches, evasion experiments, or live-match attribution. Product/UI restoration remains paused.
private_original_evidence: Local loaded-image capture used only for instruction semantics and valid/stable checks. Do not publish the private image or raw dumps.

initialization.context: ScenarioClass::StartScenario (entry 0x683AB0) successful return epilogue. Calls EA00, reproduces epilogue, returns true.
ScenarioClass::LoadGame (entry 0x67E440) completion logging point. Original log string is LOADING GAME [%s] - Complete. Restores original log then tail-calls EA00.

baseline.xrefs: Full public DLL text disassembly found direct EA00 references only in EAF0 tail jump and EB40 call; there is no EA00 call in the scan routine.

verification.algorithm: If 8-bit index >=248 reset to 0; compute CRC of start+index*16384 for 16384 bytes; compare against corresponding saved CRC; on match advance index by 1.
verification.cadence: One block each time the patched original main-loop call site is reached in an eligible mode. Original surrounding gameplay-state branches can skip the site. 248 eligible invocations complete a round; no wall-clock timing inferred.
verification.on_mismatch: Call shared fatal routine RVA E530.
verification.continuation: After validation tail-calls original 0x55DEE0 through wrapper E950.

findings.extent: Includes original game .text (0x401000..0x7E038D) plus alignment padding before.rdata at0x7E1000. All13 toolbox hook ranges in static-metadata.json and both drawing call-site hooks0x47F038/0x47F274 fall fully inside this checked extent.
findings.limitations: Static reachability proves a real integrity mechanism in this release. Does not prove which runtime DLL the user used, which baseline bytes were captured in their match, or what caused their synchronization-error UI.

findings.behavior: Replaces ESP and other registers with caller-supplied marker combinations, clears EDI, assigns EBP=EDI, and performs JMP EBP to address zero. This is an intentional invalid control transfer, not a normal return/log-only branch.
findings.limitations: No conclusion here about downstream Windows exception handling, crash dialog text, exit code, or whether a client presents a disconnect. It is not proof of the original FRAMEINFO synchronization-error path.

snapshot_sites.context: Immediately after loop calling BuildingTypeClass virtual LoadFromINI (vtable+0x64).

findings.enabled: Comparison in E690 runs only for LAN (3) or Internet (4). E5E0 also allows additional configuration-dependent snapshot cases; no claim that snapshots are exclusively multiplayer.
findings.proof: Pinned YRpp BuildingTypeClass layout cross-checked against original INI-reading instructions and actual key strings. Original code/string bytes used in this check had valid/stable mask values all1.
findings.on_mismatch: Any checked field differs from its snapshot -> shared fatal routine E530.
findings.limitations: This specifically checks three BuildingType fields; it is not evidence of blanket validation of all unit stats, money, or every object field.

checks: First eligible invocation saves HouseClass::CurrentPlayer pointer (game0xA83D4C); subsequent invocations compare the pointer against that saved value, mismatch -> E530.

Separately, if CurrentFrame(game0xA8ED84)>100, CurrentPlayer is non-null, CurrentPlayer equals HouseClass::Observer (game0xAC1198 via DLL pointer atRVA37AA0), and CurrentPlayer.Defeated at+0x1F5 is false, -> E530.
findings.limitations: Does not compare every House flag and is not a blanket assertion that any observer-flag change is fatal.

findings.behavior: Checks captured production type index (EBP) for negativity. Negative -> log invalid Heap ID and return ProdFailType::Illegal(2) through original0x4FA4A0 epilogue. Otherwise calls ObjectTypeClass::GetTechnoType(AbstractType,index) at0x48DCD0, then HouseClass::CanBuild(type,false,true) at0x4F7870. A result other than CanBuildResult::Buildable(1) -> log illegal production and same Illegal(2) return. Success resumes0x4FA36D.
findings.limitations: Only an explicit negative-index check is established in this hook. No extra upper-bound check proven here. Rejection is not the shared fatal path or a demonstrated synchronization error.

findings.behavior: For a human house, or in Campaign for IsInPlayerControl house, only Building objects invoke DisplayClass::PassesProximityCheck(type,house index,non-null foundation marker,placement cell) at0x4A8EB0. If false, constructs normal placement coordinates and returns0x4FB35F, the original placement-failure branch. The related patch removes original current-house-only early success, so the native proximity rule can run for other houses.
findings.limitations: The observed failure branch refuses placement; no E530 call. No inference that all building placement restrictions are new or unique to Hardened.

findings.behavior: If captured House pointer is non-null and IsHumanPlayer at+0x1EC is true, logs Remote EXIT and invokes HouseClass::FlagToDie(0x4FC980). For non-human houses retains original behavior: CountOtherUndefeatedHumanHouses(0x5E2BA0)==0 -> FlagToDie. Continues0x64C862.
findings.limitations: This is forced-defeat semantics for a remote EXIT, not a process scan, code checksum, or proof that the player was detected cheating.

findings.behavior: All21 original sites were individually compared. Helpers reproduce original load/store/address-of/compare operations and continuations, replacing original field storage with one DLL-owned DWORD.
findings.inference: Moving storage makes changes to the former fixed data address no longer change this state. That purpose is an inference; these helper bodies do not themselves compute CRC or report detection.

findings.category: map/rules content linked to packet decoding and payload CRC

activation.public_source: Spawner.Hook.cpp31-53 installs NetHack::SendTo and NetHack::RecvFrom at game0x7B3D75/0x7B3EEC. Spawner.h28-32 makes Enabled a constexpr true for IS_HARDENED_VER and IS_CNCNET_YR_VER. Actual Hardened initializer contains the corresponding unconditional patch-writing sequence.
activation.hardened_installation: RVA D0DB/D12A construct calls to E2E0/E3F0 and write them at the two game UDP call sites.
activation.normal_installation: Normal DLL RVA D03B/D08A select RVA8090/8190 for the same call sites.

content_source.enabled: Only LAN(3)/Internet(4) perform the added content setup; original log call is preserved in every mode.
content_source.context: Original Read_Scenario_INI entry0x686730; patched call originally logs Read_Scenario_INI - Filename is %s and its second argument is the scenario filename.
content_source.helper: RVA E970 constructs CCFileClass via0x4739F0, calls Exists via0x473C50, GetFileSize via0x473C00, allocates a buffer, reads through0x473B10, and if read length equals file size calculates CRC with E2A0. Otherwise it returns its prior accumulator unchanged.
inputs: Scenario file content, starting with zero CRC accumulator
RULESMD.INI content, continuing from the scenario content CRC
Game::Network::WOLGameID atgame0xB779D4, documented by pinnedYRpp Unsorted.h81
content_source.result: EA90 stores the derived32-bit value in DLL globalRVA73D2C. A separate value atRVA73D30 comes from WOLGameID and is used for session identification and memory-CRC initialization.
content_source.important_distinction: WOLGameID is not Game::Seed (which pinnedUnsorted.h60 locates at0xA8ED94), and these values are not the simulation RNG state.
content_source.saved_game_path: RVA EAF0, reached by LoadGame completion, updates session-derived state and the existing packet-derived value, then invokes the code-memory baseline routine. It does not call E970 to re-read both files.

send.content_use: E326 reads the file-derived32-bit value fromRVA73D2C. The send body transforms payload bytes using this repeated value and calculates a CRC of the original payload.
send.envelope: The body sends an8-byte prefix plus the transformed payload through the sendto import. It preserves the normal peer-index mapping and optional tunnel routing behavior.
send.classification: Content-dependent packet transformation plus payload integrity check. Do not describe this as cryptographic authentication or proof of an official signed-map whitelist.

receive.validation: Receives into an internal buffer; checks minimum packet size and the tunnel/session identifier as applicable. E465 reads the same file-derived value, reverses the transformation, and E49D..E4C4 recalculates the payload CRC and compares it with the prefix.
receive.failure: A mismatching payload CRC branches atE4C8 toE523, which returns-1. No call toE530 occurs on this rejection path.
receive.consequence: The receiving network path rejects the packet. Differing file/session-derived values between peers can therefore produce decode/CRC rejection, subject to the observed conditions.
receive.limits: No direct call to the original synchronization-error dialog or forced-fatal routine is established here. No live attribution of the user session.

normal_comparison.primary_source: Pinned public NetHack.cpp34-155 provides peer IP/port mapping, a direct send/recv path without a tunnel, or a4-byte tunnel-routing prefix.
normal_comparison.normal_binary: RVA8090..818D and8190..829E independently match that behavior: direct imports or raw memcpy with4-byte prefix. No file-derived payload transformation or added payload CRC appears in these function bodies.
normal_comparison.hardened_binary: E2E0..E52D adds the content-derived transformation and8-byte prefix with payload CRC to the installed packet path.
normal_comparison.diff_scope: This changes bodies selected by common initialization hooks, so counting only17 extra .syhks00 entries and46 .patch entries does not describe every Hardened behavior difference.

limits: This is separate from the launcher client SHA1 file-mismatch check and separate from FRAMEINFO simulation-state CRC.
The observed inputs are map/rules file contents at scenario loading, not ShroudCounter or MapIsClear values produced by in-game reveal calls.
Finding this mechanism does not establish that modifying map visibility necessarily changes the file-derived value.
Failure to read a file in E970 keeps the previous accumulator; the inspected helper has no signed official-content allowlist comparison or direct mismatch dialog.
This is a static comparison of two specific official released DLLs, not a live test of the user environment or a completeness claim about all anti-cheat.
